decoration: minimal — one or two subtle shapes
hero_layout: card-style — hero content inside a floating card/panel
hero_background: large faded typography watermark in background
hero_cta_style: floating action buttons with hover effects
nav_style: inline in hero — no separate nav bar, links inside hero
scroll_animation: minimal — subtle fade-up on sections (CSS only, short delay)
hover_effects: moderate — scale, shadow change, color transitions
color_scheme: mixed — alternating dark and light sections
quirk: headings use a gradient text color effect
bonus_quirk: one section has an inverted color scheme compared to the rest
